# supersedes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:supersedes`](gmeow-supersedes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/supersedes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/coreference`](../../slices/coreference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a newer entity, version, record, or claim-bearing artifact to a prior one it supersedes. Non-functional: one successor may consolidate several predecessors. Superseded entities remain first-class and usable; suppression from display is handled separately with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false when appropriate.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:supersedes`](gmeow-supersedes.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that a newer entity, version, record, or claim replaces one or more prior ones — a revised policy over its draft, a merged record consolidating several predecessors — while the superseded items stay first-class and resolvable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for lineage containment (use [`gmeow:versionOf`](gmeow-versionOf.md) or [`gmeow:editionOf`](gmeow-editionOf.md)) and for cross-realm equivalence (use [`gmeow:counterpartOf`](gmeow-counterpartOf.md)); never delete or [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) the predecessor — suppress it from display with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false if it should no longer surface.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:supersedes`](gmeow-supersedes.md) from the successor to each predecessor (non-functional, so one successor may consolidate several); keep the superseded entities in the graph and mark them [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false when they should drop out of projections.

### Examples

- ex:policyV2 [`gmeow:supersedes`](gmeow-supersedes.md) ex:policyV1.
